The goal of ecTools is to provide tools for ecosystem accounting and assessments.

## eaTools = ecTools

The package was renames ecTools in may 2026.

## Installation

You can install the development version of ecTools from [GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("NINAnor/ecTools")
```
## ecVerse

ecTools is part of **ecVerse - Ecosystem condition workflows for science and policy**

![](man/figures/logo.png){width=139 height=139} [![](man/figures/ecRxiv_hex.png){width=139 height=139}](https://ecRxiv.com) 

## ecTools 0.0.0.9004

### New features

* Added power transformations (`fun = "power"`) with a
  configurable exponent.
* Added quadratic transformations (`fun = "quadratic"`)
  with configurable curvature.

### Deprecations

* `fun = "exponential convex"` and
  `fun = "exponential concave"` are deprecated.
  These transformations were mathematically power functions
  rather than exponential functions.
* Use `fun = "power"` and `power_exponent` instead.
* Existing calls retain their original numerical behaviour
  but now issue a deprecation warning.
